describe: The image shows an aged sheet of brown card or paper with a dark olive-brown worn frame along all four edges. Faint red printed lines, small red stamp marks and a few small dark printed words and numbers sit in the corners and around the middle, with a faint stamped figure near the centre. The surface is soft, mottled and creased with fine vertical grain. Lighting is dim and even with low contrast. Fully opaque, no transparent areas.
